answer.reason: A spring release blog article is an editorial post, and the Post model ("A blog post or article") is the match. Its fields cover what was requested: a Category linked-content dropdown (Category model, Categories container), an Author linked-content dropdown (Author model, Authors container), plus Heading, Slug, PostDate, Tags, rich-text Content and an Image. Author and Category are not free text, so they must be selected from existing Author and Category items. Nothing was saved.
